description: A room-scoped private message (Camfrog PM) with display markup vs real login, and the private reply.
grounding: v1 memory pm-packet-0x60: s2c 0x60 = [display line 'Private message from DISPLAY: "TEXT"', sender LOGIN, u32 id, u64 ms timestamp]. No recipient field (an inbound PM is by definition to the bot). The PM arrives on one room's socket and the reply must go back through that room (sent as '/msg '). The bot's own sent PM echoes back as 'Private message to ...' and is not emitted as an inbound PM.

frames.note: display comes from the markup line; login is field 2. Resolve identity by id/login, never by display.

data.text: hey pepe can you not tell the room about my bet
my lips are sealed. well, my lily pad is.

frames.note: Without a room the connector cannot route a Camfrog PM (features.private_messages=room) and the user is not in any joined room.

error.message: PMs travel through a room; farawayfrog is not in any joined room
